metaphors.title: The Promethean gap
metaphors.paraphrase: Humans produce more than they can mentally represent: Prometheus's fire has outrun the mind that stole it.

metaphors.title: The bomber pilot's lagging conscience
metaphors.paraphrase: Like a pilot who could not grasp for a year what his bombs had done, our moral and cognitive grasp lags behind what AI does; the word nuke recurs.
metaphors.style_hint: A bomber silhouette over a calm town.

metaphors.title: Icarus and the g-force
metaphors.paraphrase: Machines reach the sun Icarus could not; mathematicians must train, like fighter pilots for g-forces, to keep pace with parallel, skimmable AI output.

metaphors.title: The mechanised loom
metaphors.paraphrase: As on Marx's loom, the machine performs the gesture and the worker supervises; mathematical work suffers inflationary devaluation.
metaphors.style_hint: A loom run by gears with a lone overseer.

metaphors.title: GPS and lost wayfinding
metaphors.paraphrase: As GPS has supplanted the ability to find our way, AI may supplant the ability to think our way.
metaphors.style_hint: A phone showing a route in an empty field.
